
```{r}
library(terra)

livestock_file <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/data/GPW_Livestock/LVB_GPW_livestock_2000_2022.tif"
out_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/output/livestock_pressure"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

livestock <- rast(livestock_file)
years <- 2000:2022
```

```{r}
# Convert cattle, goats and sheep to Tropical Livestock Units

tlu_layers <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  cattle <- livestock[[paste0("cattle_", yr)]]
  goat <- livestock[[paste0("goat_", yr)]]
  sheep <- livestock[[paste0("sheep_", yr)]]

  (0.7 * cattle) + (0.1 * goat) + (0.1 * sheep)
})

tlu_stack <- do.call(c, tlu_layers)
names(tlu_stack) <- paste0("TLU_", years)

cell_area_km2 <- cellSize(tlu_stack[[1]], unit = "km")
tlu_density <- tlu_stack / cell_area_km2
names(tlu_density) <- paste0("TLU_density_", years)
```

```{r}
# Basin-wide livestock change

tlu_total <- global(tlu_stack, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]

plot(years, tlu_total, type = "l", lwd = 2, xlab = "Year", ylab = "Tropical Livestock Units")
```

```{r}
# Annual livestock density trend

tlu_slope_fun <- function(x) {
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  if (sum(ok) < 15) return(NA)
  coef(lm(x[ok] ~ years[ok]))[2]
}

tlu_slope <- app(tlu_density, tlu_slope_fun)
names(tlu_slope) <- "TLU_density_slope_2000_2022"

plot(tlu_slope)
```

```{r}
# Direction of livestock trends

v <- values(tlu_slope, mat = FALSE)
v <- v[is.finite(v)]

tlu_summary <- data.frame(
  class = c("Decrease", "No change", "Increase"),
  cells = c(sum(v < 0), sum(v == 0), sum(v > 0))
)

tlu_summary$percent <- 100 * tlu_summary$cells / sum(tlu_summary$cells)

tlu_summary
```

```{r}
writeRaster(tlu_slope, file.path(out_dir, "TLU_density_annual_slope_2000_2022.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
